title: StarFighter 16-Inch
summary: Star Labs launches the StarFighter 16-inch Linux laptop, expanding their lineup of purpose-built Linux computers with a larger display form factor for developers and power users seeking desktop-class productivity on the go.
problem_solved: Provides a larger-screen Linux-native laptop option for developers and enthusiasts who want a 16-inch display with fully supported Linux out of the box.
why_valuable: Delivers a well-engineered 16-inch Linux laptop with optimized hardware-software integration, filling the gap for users who need larger displays without sacrificing the Linux experience.
